voice_script.hook_line: Oh my goodness, look at that tiny little friend! A ladybug wearing a beautiful red coat with fancy black polka dots!
voice_script.transition_line: I bet this ladybug isn't the only spotty thing around here. You are now an official Polka-Dot Patrol Officer! Your mission is to find three more things with dots, spots, or circles.

rounds.prompt: Keep your eyes super wide open! Can you find something with spots or dots on it? Maybe a flower, a rock, or a leaf?
rounds.on_correct: You found it! Oh, look at those lovely little dots — they look just like tiny polka-dot freckles! That is our first find, Officer!
rounds.on_incorrect: That's a great find! Let me look more closely — I can see a little pattern there! Every little detail counts on patrol.
rounds.on_silence: It's okay to take your time, Officer. Maybe try looking at flowers up close, or at the ground near your feet. Do you see anything with dots?
rounds.hint: Try looking at flowers up close — sometimes their petals have the most amazing tiny dots!
rounds.on_wrong_photo: Hmm, that one doesn't have dots on it. Would you like to look for something with spots or circles instead?

rounds.prompt: Patrol report! We need our second find. Can you spot something else with dots, spots, or speckles nearby?
rounds.on_correct: Incredible detective work! Look at those little speckles — nature painted those on! That's two spotted treasures found!
rounds.on_incorrect: Hmm, let me look closer — you know what, I can see a little pattern there! Good spotting, Officer!
rounds.on_silence: You're doing such a great job, Officer. Maybe look down at the ground near our feet? Sometimes pebbles or tree bark have the best little speckles.
rounds.hint: Try looking at the ground — little pebbles and stones sometimes have amazing spotted patterns!
rounds.on_wrong_photo: That's not quite what we're looking for. Can you find something with dots or speckles on it?

rounds.prompt: Last one, Officer! Can you find one more thing with spots or dots to complete our patrol collection?
rounds.on_correct: You did it! Collection complete! You found three amazing spotted treasures. What an incredible Polka-Dot Patrol Officer you are!
rounds.on_incorrect: You know what, I think that counts! Every little pattern tells a story. Our collection is complete, Officer!
rounds.on_silence: We're so close! Try looking at tree bark up close, or the underside of a leaf. Even tiny things can have beautiful dot patterns.
rounds.hint: Try looking at tree bark up close — it often has amazing little spotted patterns!
rounds.on_wrong_photo: Almost! That one doesn't have dots though. One more look — can you spot something with a dotty pattern?

voice_script.closing_speech: Congratulations, Polka-Dot Patrol Officer! You noticed the beautiful Form of spots and patterns everywhere, and found a surprising Connection between all these different spotted things. A tiny ladybug, and all your amazing finds — all connected by their wonderful dots!
voice_script.tomorrow_hook: Next time you're outside, keep your patrol eyes open — spots and dots are hiding everywhere, waiting for you to discover them!
voice_script.synthesis_speech: Now let's look at all your spotted treasures together! Each one has dots or spots, but they all look so different — big dots, tiny speckles, round circles. Isn't it amazing how the same pattern can look so many different ways?
voice_script.early_exit_speech: Great patrol work today, Officer! You found some wonderful spotted treasures. The polka dots will be waiting for you next time!

widget_params.description: Ladybug photo centered with spots gently highlighted
